title: Opening — one Math Engine, a dotted line across the gap in plan, nothing in 3D
description:
A parametric VACANT OPENING on the six-node spine, SEGMENT-hosted like a door or window:

  Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render (no 3D Render)

WHAT IT IS FOR. Any gap in a wall that has nothing in it — an arch between two rooms, a servery, a balcony's open side. It fills its host piece under "Fill segment", so it goes on a pre-cut opening piece whose SEGMENT keeps the neighbouring wall's thickness (that is what keeps the mitred wall ends square and what the space label insets by), but which carries NO Wall object: an opening is the absence of wall, so nothing may stand in it — in 2D or in 3D.

WHAT IT DRAWS. One dotted line along the wall centreline across the clear width (`dashLength` / `dashGap` set the pattern), and nothing else. No lintel, no jamb marks, no sill or parapet wall, and nothing at all in 3D — the 3D view must show the gap.

THICKNESS. `thickness` is the wall depth the gap sits in and should equal the host piece's segment thickness; it is reported as a metric and is not drawn. `wallDepth` is the pre-2026-09 name for the same number and is still read when Thickness is left at 0.

WHAT IT REPORTS. Clear width and height, open area, thickness, and the dash count.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO. No arch profile, no frame, no grille, no parapet — those are the Window's, the Channel Gate's, and a low Wall's.

props.name: Semantics
props.value: open verandah bay, plastered reveals, RCC lintel over, no frame

params.name: Opening maths
params.expr:
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_n = rows(P)
_isSeg = _n == 2
_isSpace = _n > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_eLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_eLen)
_mask = eq(_eLen, _longest)
_sDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, _mask), 0) : _e1
_sA = _isSpace ? row(compress(P, _mask), 0) : row(P, 0)
_segV = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _sDir
_dir = _isSeg ? _segV : (_isSpace ? _sDir : _e1)
_dLen = min(len(_dir))
_u = _dLen > 1e-9 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_ux = sub(_u, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_u, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = 0 - _uy
_vy = _ux
_hosted = (_isSeg || _isSpace) && _dLen > 1e-9
_fill = fitMode == 'Fill segment'
_W = _hosted ? (_fill ? _dLen : min(max(0.3, width), _dLen)) : max(0.3, width)
_pA = _isSpace ? _sA : row(P, 0)
_pax = sub(_pA, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_pay = sub(_pA, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_mx = _hosted ? _pax + _ux * _dLen / 2 : _pax
_my = _hosted ? _pay + _uy * _dLen / 2 : _pay
_hw = _W / 2
_cu = _mx * _ux + _my * _uy
_cv = _mx * _vx + _my * _vy
# Thickness of the piece — matches the wall it interrupts, so the band does not taper at the reveals.
# `wallDepth` is the pre-2026-09 name for the same number: honoured when Thickness is left at 0.
_t = max(0.02, wallDepth > 0.001 ? wallDepth : (thickness > 0.001 ? thickness : 0.23))
_hd = _t / 2
_jw = jambWidth
# An opening is VACANT: it draws one dotted line across the gap on the wall centreline in plan and nothing in
# 3D — no lintel, no jambs, no sill wall. The host segment keeps the wall thickness (for the mitre at its ends and
# the space-label inset); this object only marks where the wall is absent.
_dl = max(0.02, dashLength)
_dg = max(0.01, dashGap)
_pitch = _dl + _dg
_nd = max(1, floor((_W + _dg) / _pitch))
_run = _nd * _pitch - _dg
_s0 = 0 - _run / 2
_k = arange(_nd)
_u0 = _cu + _s0 + _k * _pitch
_u1 = _u0 + _dl
DottedPlan = hcat(_u0 * _ux + _cv * _vx, _u0 * _uy + _cv * _vy, _u1 * _ux + _cv * _vx, _u1 * _uy + _cv * _vy)
# Metrics
clearWidth = _W
clearHeight = lintelHeight
openArea = _W * lintelHeight
openingThickness = _t
dashCount = _nd
